about: The Workbench icons of the EDuke32 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/eduke32.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/eduke32.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. EDuke32-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, EDuke32.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's EDuke32.info. GameData.info is the icon of the drawer for the user's DUKE3D.GRP. The tool types in brackets are off; take the brackets away to use one (each tool type starting with '-' is a command-line switch).
